cash_tip: Papá Omar and Jahgyro Gyros both take cards, so you can save your pesos for places that only take cash. When you do withdraw, use a bank ATM in town, choose 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos, take out one bigger amount, and keep small bills for tacos, taxis and the market.
